         RETURN s.slug AS slug, coalesce(s.canonicalName, s.title) AS title

MATCH (:`Operation` {slug: $slug})-[r:HAS_IMAGE]->(s:Source)
         WHERE coalesce(s.kind, 'photograph') = 'photograph'
         RETURN s.id AS id, s.url AS url, coalesce(r.caption, s.title) AS caption
         ORDER BY coalesce(r.order, 9999), s.id

MATCH (e {slug: $slug}) WHERE e:Incident OR e:Operation
     OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:ORCHESTRATED_BY]->(org:Organization)
     OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:IN_DISTRICT]->(dist:Unit)
     RETURN CASE WHEN 'Operation' IN labels(e) THEN 'operation' ELSE 'incident' END AS kind,
            coalesce(e.codeName, e.canonicalName, e.title) AS title,
            e.date AS date,
            org.canonicalName AS organization,
            dist.canonicalName AS district

queries.query:
MATCH (e) WHERE e:Incident OR e:Operation
         OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:ORCHESTRATED_BY]->(org:Organization)
         OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:IN_DISTRICT]->(dist:Unit)
         OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:HAS_IMAGE]->(img:Source)
           WHERE coalesce(img.kind, 'photograph') = 'photograph'
         WITH e, org, dist, img ORDER BY coalesce(img.id, '')
         WITH e, org, dist, head(collect(img)) AS firstImg
         RETURN e.slug AS slug,
                coalesce(e.codeName, e.canonicalName, e.title) AS title,
                e.date AS date,
                org.canonicalName AS organization,
                dist.canonicalName AS district,
                firstImg.url AS thumbnailUrl
         ORDER BY e.date ASC, title ASC

queries.query:
MATCH (i:Incident)
    RETURN i.slug AS slug,
           i.title + CASE WHEN i.date IS NOT NULL THEN ' · ' + i.date ELSE '' END AS name
    ORDER BY i.date DESC, i.title

MATCH (l:Location)
    RETURN l.slug AS slug, coalesce(l.canonicalName, l.title) AS name
    ORDER BY name

MATCH (n {slug: $slug})
       WHERE n:Incident OR n:Operation
       RETURN CASE WHEN 'Operation' IN labels(n) THEN 'operation' ELSE 'incident' END AS kind,
              coalesce(n.codeName, n.canonicalName, n.title) AS name,
              n.date AS date

queries.query:
MATCH (n) WHERE n.slug IS NOT NULL AND (n:Operation OR n:Incident OR n:Person OR n:Location OR n:Transport OR n:Station OR n:Outline OR n:Organization OR n:EquipmentType)
    AND (n.slug = $exact OR toLower(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(n.slug, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '_', ''), '.', ''), '/', '')) IN $keys)
  RETURN labels(n)[0] AS label, n.slug AS slug
  LIMIT 40

MATCH (o:Organization)
    RETURN o.slug AS slug, o.canonicalName AS name
    ORDER BY o.canonicalName

queries.query:
MATCH (op:Operation {slug: $slug})-[:FROM]->(l:Location)
    RETURN l.slug AS targetSlug, coalesce(l.canonicalName, l.title) AS targetName
    LIMIT 1

MATCH (op:Operation {slug: $slug})-[:FROM_STATION]->(s:Station)
    RETURN s.slug AS targetSlug, coalesce(s.canonicalName, s.title) AS targetName
    LIMIT 1

MATCH (op:Operation {slug: $slug})-[:ORCHESTRATED_BY]->(o:Organization)
      RETURN o.slug AS targetSlug, o.canonicalName AS targetName
      ORDER BY targetName

MATCH (op:Operation {slug: $slug})-[:RELATED_TO {kind:'contains'}]->(i:Incident)
      RETURN i.slug AS targetSlug,
             i.title + CASE WHEN i.date IS NOT NULL THEN ' · ' + i.date ELSE '' END AS targetName
      ORDER BY i.date, targetName

MATCH (op:Operation {slug: $slug})-[:TO]->(l:Location)
    RETURN l.slug AS targetSlug, coalesce(l.canonicalName, l.title) AS targetName
    LIMIT 1

MATCH (op:Operation {slug: $slug})-[:TO_STATION]->(s:Station)
    RETURN s.slug AS targetSlug, coalesce(s.canonicalName, s.title) AS targetName
    LIMIT 1

MATCH (op:Operation)
    RETURN op.slug AS slug, op.codeName AS name
    ORDER BY op.codeName

queries.query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:INVOLVED_IN|PARTICIPATED_IN]->(:`Operation` {slug: $slug})
       RETURN DISTINCT p.slug AS slug, p.canonicalName AS name
       ORDER BY name

MATCH (p:Person)-[:PARTICIPATED_IN]->(op:Operation {slug: $slug})
      OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:HAS_OPERATION_NOTE]->(d:Description)-[:ABOUT_OPERATION]->(op)
      OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:SOURCED_FROM]->(from:Source)
      WITH p, d, from
      OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[cites:CITES]->(src:Source)
      WITH p, d, from,
           collect(CASE WHEN src IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {
             inline:       coalesce(cites.inline, false),
             sourceId:     src.id,
             sourceTitle:  src.title,
             sourceUrl:    src.url,
             sourceAuthor: src.authorFreeText
           } END) AS rawCites
      WITH p, d, from,
           CASE WHEN d IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {
             order:     coalesce(d.order, 1),
             content:   d.content,
             citations: [x IN rawCites WHERE x IS NOT NULL],
             sourcedFrom: CASE WHEN from IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {
               id:             from.id,
               title:          from.title,
               url:             from.url,
               authorFreeText: from.authorFreeText,
               license:        from.license,
               attribution:    from.attribution
             } END
           } END AS section
      WITH p, collect(section) AS rawSections
      RETURN p.slug AS targetSlug, p.canonicalName AS targetName,
             [x IN rawSections WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS sections
      ORDER BY targetName

MATCH (parent:Operation {slug: $slug})-[:RELATED_TO {kind:'contains'}]->(child:Operation)
      RETURN child.slug AS targetSlug, child.codeName AS targetName
      ORDER BY targetName

MATCH (s:Station)
    RETURN s.slug AS slug, coalesce(s.canonicalName, s.title) AS name,
           [(s)-[:HAS_NAME]->(n:Name) | n.value] AS aliases
    ORDER BY name
